design: Six controlled deterministic correction-head trials on one verified frozen Huber+EMD encoder
checkpoint_selection: Among complete full-train/full-val epochs: prefer all 8 Res/Trace nonworse than historical Huber+EMD, then minimum mean log W1 ratio; if none eligible, minimum mean 12 log metric ratios. Retain MSE-best separately for historical comparison.
correction: Two trainable128-unit SiLU layers; zero-initialized4-output head; delta_z=0.5*tanh(raw); add to exact existing physical prediction
group_definition: Fixed full-train baseline predicted mass tertypes: bottom60%, next30%, highest10%; no truth routing or movement between groups

cot.loss: Training-group-weighted32-direction joint slicedW2 squared; not a learned optimal Monge-map implementation

proxy.update: Once per complete training epoch using sample-weighted online hard violations
proxy.description: Proxy-based projected primal-dual adaptation: true TRAIN macroTrace and two signed-tail rates update12multipliers; differentiable proxies update model; not exact Cotter game or guaranteed deterministic feasibility

ranksim.scope: Only trainable correction-head representation; original Transformer embedding frozen

flowalign.description: Fresh paired conditional velocity field on4D original standardized target paths; frozen field used only in correction training, direct deterministic inference

limitations: frozen encoder/head-only screening; not full retraining of original papers
conditionalOT andproxyframework are task adaptations, not exact paper reproductions
same22min ceilings but completedepochs may differ
RankSim pairs use256rows/batch; all rows participate in main loss
FlowAlign has a separately budgeted field job; include its cost
train-derived references do not guarantee validation/test feasibility
